meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, studies of company finances (DBIE, via the local Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Each study is final for its own sample of companies; a later study re-measures the earlier year on a different sample, kept beside it, never chained.
meta.product: DBIE report 1075 (sources and uses of funds of listed private manufacturing companies, half-yearly, discontinued)
meta.coverage: Where listed private manufacturing companies got their money and what they spent it on, April to September 2018 and 2019
meta.note: Shares of total sources or total uses, per cent; the totals in ₹ crore. Only two half-years were published (April to September 2018, final; April to September 2019, provisional) before the RBI discontinued the table. Each half-year is dated by its first month.
